fixture_manifest.provenance: Newly authored synthetic fixtures; no private documents or user data.

methodology.observations: Counts are read from saved Qwen tokenizer measurements, not Mercury or another diffusion tokenizer.
methodology.full_sequence_quadratic: W=sum_i N_i^2 for separate fixture requests, never (sum_i N_i)^2; cost=K*W.
methodology.step_break_even: For the same K ratio on every fixture, M is faster only when K_M/K_baseline is strictly below the reported ratio. Equality is a tie; ratios below 1 require fewer M steps.
methodology.fixed_block: W=sum_i ceil(N_i/B). Each request is independently padded; cost=K*W*C(B), with the same cost per fixed block and steps per block. No prefix, partial-block, or cache model.
methodology.critical_limit: Payload and complete INPUT prompt lengths are hypothetical work proxies. Generated output lengths, denoising steps, output padding, cache behavior, quality, and measured diffusion latency are absent from the source.
methodology.unknown_costs: Ignores fixed overhead, bandwidth/compute mixture, vocabulary-head changes, translation, validation, retries, batching, hardware, and learned parallel dependencies. These idealized values are not measured speedups or universal upper bounds.
methodology.exclusion_policy: If any format/tokenizer/scope has text-fidelity failure, special IDs, or unknown IDs, exclude that fixture from every format, tokenizer, and scope in the second view. The first view retains all diagnostics.
methodology.corpus_limit: 33 authored smoke fixtures and public holdouts do not establish general-language compression or trained-model performance.
